speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

aiek-normal.name: AI Engineering Kit: Normal lane
aiek-normal.description: specify → plan → tasks (READY TO BUILD gate via hook) → implement (verify + review via hooks). No explicit human gates; requires agent-observed readiness and completion checks.

aiek-large.name: AI Engineering Kit: Large / Risky lane
aiek-large.description: specify → clarify → plan → human decision gate → tasks → analyze → READY TO BUILD gate → implement (verify + independent review via hooks).
